instruction: Why are instances in Auto Scaling Group {{troubleshooting-multiservice-elbv2-n35haewp6-us-west-2-ASGName}} failing health checks in us-west-2?
expected_answer:
The security group {{troubleshooting-multiservice-elbv2-n35haewp6-us-west-2-SecurityGroupId}} attached to the instances does not allow inbound traffic on port 4000, which is the health check port configured on target group {{troubleshooting-multiservice-elbv2-n35haewp6-us-west-2-TargetGroupName}}.

The target group uses HTTP health checks on port 4000 at path /health-check. With a Network Load Balancer, health check traffic comes from the NLB's private IP address in the subnet, not from a security group reference. The security group only has self-referencing ingress rules (TCP 988, TCP 1018-1023, and all-traffic from itself), so the NLB health check packets are dropped. This causes the ASG to continuously cycle instances: they launch, fail the ELB health check after the grace period, get terminated, and a replacement is launched.
